text:
maya: Hey team — bring-up of cosmosx-7b-quant on Redwood showing big regressions after HF->Redwood conversion. Eval run shows perplexity jump and embedding drift. Converter logs had weight-rename warnings, a rev-pin mismatch, and a 403 on one safetensors shard. Opening thread to triage.

josh: Which exact HF repo + revision?

maya: repo=cosmosx/cosmosx-7b rev= v2.0.1-quant
Logs: 
```
convert --from hf --repo cosmosx/cosmosx-7b --rev v2.0.1-quant --out /tmp/cosmosx-conv
[WARN] renaming weight key transformer.h.0.attn.q_proj.weight -> transformer.h.0.attn.q_proj.weight_renamed
[ERROR] rev pin mismatch: requested v2.0.1-quant but snapshot had 3 shards; expecting 4
[ERROR] hf_hub download 403 for _safetensors_shard_3of4.safetensors
```

josh: 403 usually auth / token rotation. Did you pass HF token? Try HF_TOKEN env or `convert --hf-token`. The rename warnings mean our keymap didn't account for the model's new naming scheme — I'm preparing an expanded mapping.

ben: Also check tokenizer and special tokens quickly — quant shouldn't affect those but good to verify: 
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("cosmosx/cosmosx-7b", revision="v2.0.1-quant")
print(t.special_tokens_map)
```

maya: ran tokenizer check — special tokens present. But embeddings vs HF baseline are off: cosine ~0.81 vs expected ~0.98. Perplexity numbers: converted model ppl=12.3, HF baseline ppl=4.1.

rachel: Could be shard ordering + partial download. HF hub sometimes lists safetensors shards in an order that our downloader assumed lexicographic; if shard 3 fails with 403 we might stitch wrong shards. Use `hf_hub_download(..., use_auth_token=True)` to re-download and verify sha256 in index.json.

convert-bot: Notified: new conversion build "convert-v0.19.3" pushed to staging.

josh: I pushed a quick change to validate total tensor count and to compare shard sha256 hashes against the hub index.json. Try staging binary with `--retry-download`.

maya: running convert-v0.19.3 now...

maya: Update: convert succeeded with staging build, all 4 shards fetched, rename warnings gone. Evals improved but not identical: ppl=5.8, embeddings cosine=0.93. Some hallucination cases persist on our tool-calling eval.

ben: Which quant backend did you use? AQT / LLM.int8 / q4_0? Some quant configs (per-channel symmetric) can break kv-cache math leading to subtle generation drift. Please paste the convert command.

maya: command used: 
```
convert --from hf --repo cosmosx/cosmosx-7b --rev v2.0.1-quant --out /mnt/models/cosmosx-quant \ 
  --quantize llm.int8 --preserve-special-tokens --retry-download
```

ben: Try `--quantize q4_0` as an ablation — q4_0 gave more stable semantics in past runs (higher accuracy, slightly worse latency).

maya: Tried q4_0: embeddings cos=0.96, ppl=4.5, latency +12% but quality much closer to baseline. Will run full eval sweep.

rachel: Another note: converter dropped `chat_template` from config.json during mapping to Redwood model.json; that can change prompt wrapping and cause hallucination in chat evaluation. Use `--dump-config` to inspect what was emitted.

maya: `--dump-config` shows chat_template missing indeed. Filed GH issue #522: "convert: preserve chat_template and metadata for chat models" and attached a minimal repro.

josh: ack, I will add chat_template -> model.config.chat_template to our mapping and backfill conversions when possible. Also will include a keymap update for the transformer weight renames. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI: convert-v0.19.3 staging build passed unit + integration tests (download/resume behaviors).

maya: Next steps: josh to merge keymap + chat_template PR, rachel to add auth-fallback + retry improvements to downloader, ben to run quant recipe sweep (narrow toward q4_0 default for this workload), maya will re-run full eval and update ticket with full logs & samples. Thanks everyone :pray:
